memories.content: The board has called a special general meeting for the 12th to vote on amending the pet policy. They know the bylaws require a two-thirds member turnout for the amendment to pass. They have sent out notices to all members about the meeting and the proposed amendment.

Sunmark housing cooperative is a residential cooperative. Its bylaws require a two-thirds turnout of all members for any amendment to the pet policy to be valid. A special general meeting has been called for 2026-09-12 to vote on such an amendment. The meeting will be held at the cooperative's common hall. Members can attend in person or by proxy. The cutoff for counting turnout is the end of the meeting, scheduled for 22:00.
